description: This file defines internal data structures, external variables, and function prototypes related to jemalloc's statistics collection and reporting.

methods.name: stats_print
methods.description: Function to print statistics, takes a write callback, callback opaque, and options string.

methods.name: stats_cactive_get
methods.description: Inline function returning the current active stats size using atomic read.

methods.description: Inline function adding a size to the active stats counter atomically.
